welcome.title: Welcome to your doctor portal
welcome.body: Let's walk through how you'll actually work here — start to finish, across the pages you'll use most.

overview.title: Today's overview
overview.body: See today's schedule and what needs your attention at a glance. This is your home base after every login.

availabilityForm.title: Set your availability first
availabilityForm.body: Add your weekly working hours here before anything else — they generate the booking slots patients actually see. Do this before touching the calendar.

availabilityWeek.title: The week grid
availabilityWeek.body: Click an open slot to mark it busy or blocked. Click a blocked slot again to reopen it.

availabilityWindows.title: Recurring windows
availabilityWindows.body: Review, edit, or delete the recurring weekly windows you've set up. Changes here ripple forward to future weeks.

calendarAdd.title: Add availability for a date range
calendarAdd.body: Need extra hours on specific dates? Add them here without touching your standing weekly schedule.

calendarTimeoff.title: Block time off
calendarTimeoff.body: Going away? Block a whole date range as time off. Unblock it the same way if plans change.

appointmentsSummary.title: Your daily queue
appointmentsSummary.body: See open consultations and appointments not yet finalized at a glance — this is what needs action today.

demoAppointment.title: A sample appointment
demoAppointment.body: Join starts the video visit. Open takes you into the consultation workspace where you do the clinical work.

demoSoap.title: The consultation note
demoSoap.body: Inside the workspace you write the SOAP note — chief complaint, subjective, objective, assessment, plan. Save drafts as you go, then sign to finalize — signed notes lock.

demoForms.title: Clinical forms
demoForms.body: Fill clinical form templates during the consultation when needed. Submissions save straight to the appointment record.

demoDocuments.title: Documents
demoDocuments.body: Generate prescriptions, exam referrals, and absence certificates from here. They land in a review & send queue before reaching the patient.

forms.title: Form templates
forms.body: Manage the reusable form templates you fill during consultations.

invoices.title: Invoices
invoices.body: Track earnings and invoices for your consultations.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.body: Stay on top of new appointments and messages the moment they come in.

profile.title: Your public profile
profile.body: Manage the photo, bio, and credentials patients see when choosing a doctor.

workspace.title: Your consultation workspace
workspace.body: Everything for this visit lives in one place — overview, notes, forms, and documents, all in these tabs.

workspaceSoap.title: The consultation note
workspaceSoap.body: Write the SOAP note here — chief complaint, subjective, objective, assessment, plan. Save drafts as you go, then sign to finalize — signed notes lock.

workspaceForms.title: Clinical forms
workspaceForms.body: Fill clinical form templates for this consultation when needed. Submissions save straight to the appointment record.

workspaceDocuments.title: Documents
workspaceDocuments.body: Generate prescriptions, exam referrals, and absence certificates from here. They land in a review & send queue before reaching the patient.
